description: A quadratic equation is a fundamental part of algebra where the maximum power of the variable is 2. In this topic, we study the roots of the equation and their properties to solve various algebraic problems.

sections.title: Standard Form
sections.description: The general way to represent any quadratic equation.

key_concepts.explanation: The unknown quantity whose value needs to be determined.
Here, a and b are the coefficients of x^2 and x respectively, and c is the constant term. Necessary condition: a cannot be zero (a ≠ 0).

sections.title: Discriminant and Nature of Roots
sections.description: The discriminant determines the exact nature and type of the roots of the equation.

key_concepts.explanation: This is the value that decides whether the roots of the equation will be real, equal, or imaginary.

results: No real roots (imaginary or complex roots).

sections.title: Methods of Solving Equations
sections.description: The primary mathematical methods used to find the roots of a quadratic equation.

steps.title: Splitting the Middle Term
steps.detail: In the factorization method, split the middle term 'bx' into two parts such that their sum is 'b' and their product is 'a*c'.

steps.title: Taking Common Factors
steps.detail: Group the terms and extract the common factors from these pairs.

steps.title: Equating to Zero
steps.detail: Set both linear factors equal to zero to find the possible values of x.

sections.title: Relationship between Roots and Coefficients
sections.description: The algebraic relationships connecting the roots of the equation with its coefficients.

equations: α * β = c / a (Product of roots)

key_concepts.explanation: The specific values of the variable x that completely satisfy the given quadratic equation.

sections.title: Forming a Quadratic Equation
sections.description: The process of constructing a quadratic equation when its roots are already known.

steps.title: Find the Sum
steps.detail: Add the given roots together to calculate their sum.

steps.title: Find the Product
steps.detail: Multiply the given roots together to calculate their product.

steps.title: Substitute in Formula
steps.detail: Substitute the calculated values of the sum and product into the standard formation formula.
